name: Link No Protocol Widget
description: Provides a widget to contribute links without the protocol.
project_description:
This module provides a widget that allows you to not contribute the protocol at the start of the URLs when you want to contribute a Link field.

 Why this module? 

You find it annoying to have to type https://www.mozilla.org with HTTPS instead of just www.mozilla.org ? Then this module is for you, it will make the life of your users easier when they have to contribute external links.

 How to use 

- Create a field of type Link

- Go in the form display of your entity

- Select the Link No Protocol widget

- Configure your widget
